messages:
sam: Short thread: we need a tiny rule for post-launch patch vs next-minor. Loudest-first is causing churn. Proposal: 1) 48h triage owner, 2) fastpatch if regression/security or >=3 paying customers affected and no workaround, 3) else schedule. Thoughts?

oliver: yes to 48h owner. add a dev-estimate gate: if >3d, schedule unless P1.

maya: Also require a minimal rollout checklist: smoke tests, canary (5%->25%->100%), auto-rollback on error spike. @sre-bot any defaults?

sre-bot: Recommend canary 5% for 10m, 25% for 10m, then 100% if healthy. Auto-rollback on error spike or latency >2x. Link: https://internal/runbooks/fastpatchs

sam: OK. I'll draft a one-pager + slash template `/fastpatch request <ISSUE>` with fields: reporter, severity, customers_impacted, repro, workaround, est_effort, suggested_action. Owner rota volunteers?

oliver: I can take week 1.

maya: I'll pair with SRE on the smoke checklist.

sam: Action items: sam -> publish one-pager + template; oliver -> week1 rota; maya -> smoke checklist. If no objections I'll post the draft in #product-docs today.

oliver: No objections. :rocket:
